Network Technology Case Studies Fact Sheets and Guides Reports Glossary Trackers and Dashboards Webinars Start Here Digital Opportunity Lab Start a Community Network Sign Up For a Network Educate Your Local Community Subscribe Donate Big Brother is Watching You - Episode 678 of the Community Broadband Bits Podcast By Jordan Pittman on Mar 2, 2026 In this episode of the podcast, we welcome back Sascha Meinrath for a timely and urgent conversation about surveillance, digital infrastructure, and the growing tension between connectivity and civil liberties. Sascha explores how modern broadband networks are increasingly intertwined with systems of data extraction, monitoring, and behavioral tracking. The conversation digs into how surveillance operates at multiple levels: through corporate data collection, government monitoring, and emerging technologies that blur the line between public safety and privacy intrusion. This episode challenges us to think beyond speed and access, and to grapple with what kind of digital future we are actually building. If communities are investing in digital infrastructure, Sascha argues, they must also ask: Who controls the data? Who benefits? And who is being watched?
